# [PR #14573] [#13082][fix] Add fail-fast FP4/MXFP4 GPU compatibility validation

source: https://github.com/NVIDIA/TensorRT-LLM/pull/14573
state: closed | updated: 2026-09-25T05:11:31Z
labels: Community want to contribute, Investigating

## 正文

Fixes #13082

## Description

Adds fail-fast validation for FP4/MXFP4 quantization modes on unsupported GPU architectures

Previously, unsupported FP4/MXFP4 execution paths could proceed into lower-level kernels or backend initialization and fail later with less actionable errors. This patch centralizes GPU support checks in `QuantMode` helpers and applies validation across custom ops, linear layers, and fused MoE backend creation

### Changes
- Add FP4/MXFP4 GPU support helpers in `quantization/mode.py`
- Validate FP4 runtime support before NVFP4 and W4A8 MXFP4 custom GEMMs
- Validate FP4 quant configs during linear weight creation
- Validate fused MoE backend support before backend construction
- Raise clear errors for unsupported architectures or missing FP4 metadata

This change is independent of VILA multimodal chunked prefill fixes

## Test Coverage

- Verified FP4/MXFP4 validation paths trigger early failures on unsupported GPU architectures
- Verified supported configurations continue through backend and kernel setup successfully
- Existing quantization and fused MoE test paths continue to pass

## Walkthrough

This PR unifies GEMM output buffer handling via a `to_userbuffers` pathway, adds SM-level MXFP4 support validation, simplifies MoE backend selection logic, and significantly refactors NVFP4 weight loading and linear inference. AllReduce preallocation is simplified and a cache-miss fallback strategy is changed from NCCL_SYMMETRIC to plain NCCL.

## Changes

**Quantization-aware Linear and GEMM Refactoring**

|Layer / File(s)|Summary|
|---|---|
|**MXFP4 support validation and SM detection utilities** <br> `tensorrt_llm/quantization/mode.py`, `tensorrt_llm/_torch/custom_ops/torch_custom_ops.py`|New helpers read CUDA SM version from torch, check MXFP4 support against SM allowlists, and format unsupported-architecture error messages. Runtime FP4 validation is gated before NVFP4 unified runner construction.|
|**Unified GEMM output buffer via `to_userbuffers`** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/custom_ops/torch_custom_ops.py`|Replaces `output_buffer_kind`/`group` plumbing with `to_userbuffers: bool` across FP8Rowwise, FP4, CublasLtFP4, CudaCoreNVFP4, unified NVFP4, W4A8MXFP4FP8, and WeightOnlyQuant runners and custom ops; updates all `register_fake` signatures.|
|**AllReduce preallocation and cache-miss fallback simplification** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/custom_ops/torch_custom_ops.py`|Removes `AllReduceRunner` preallocation config class variables, simplifies `_maybe_preallocate_buffers` signature, removes headroom-based dummy tensor logic, changes cache-miss fallback to plain NCCL, and removes `inputs_pre_hook` from autotuning.|
|**Supporting GEMM refactors** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/custom_ops/torch_custom_ops.py`|Consolidates FinegrainedMixedDtypeGemm SM-version gating, implements `deep_gemm_gen_tuning_buckets` locally, refactors FP8 block-scaling constraint-spec builder, and removes deprecated tunable FP4 quantization section.|
|**MoE backend FP4 support validation and selection simplification** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/fused_moe/create_moe.py`|Adds private FP4 and backend-support validators, removes `layer_idx` parameter from `get_moe_cls`, eliminates CuteDslB12xFusedMoE and FlashInfer routing, restricts load-balancer backends, and removes `resolve_moe_cls` flow from `create_moe`.|
|**FP4 utility functions and Linear method base refactoring** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|Adds FP4 utilities to select quant mode, validate SM support, and enforce required metadata; refactors `LinearMethodBase.load_weights()` to dispatch by `WeightMode` with `allow_partial_loading` restricted to `UnquantizedLinearMethod`.|
|**UnquantizedLinearMethod: cuBLAS op fallback and output buffer removal** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|Initializes `rebuild_tensor_metadata` during weight creation; simplifies `apply()` to route through custom cuBLAS MM op or fall back to `F.linear`; removes CUTLASS/cute-DSL BF16 GEMM paths and NCCL window output-buffer routing.|
|**FP8 GEMM methods: output buffer removal** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|Updates FP8QDQLinearMethod and FP8RowwiseLinearMethod to remove `output_buffer_kind`/`group` computation and NCCL symmetric window routing while preserving cuda-core vs cublas GEMM selection.|
|**NVFP4 execution and weight loading: input prep, GEMM, scale loading, and padding** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|Tightens input checks, uses `torch.ops.trtllm.fp4_quantize` for activation, updates `nvfp4_gemm` to pass `to_userbuffers=False` without NCCL window params, replaces shard-key accumulator with TP-aware `load_weight_scales()`, rewrites fused qkv/gate-up loaders, and updates post-load padding with block interleaving.|
|**W4A8MXFP4FP8: quant_mode parameter and metadata enforcement** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|Extends `W4A8MXFP4FP8LinearMethod.load_weight_scales()` with optional `quant_mode` parameter; enforces required FP4 metadata via helper; updates all call sites.|
|**Linear module: FP4 validation, forward path, and partial loading restriction** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/modules/linear.py`|`Linear.create_weights()` validates FP4 support; `Linear.forward()` removes NCCL symmetric window fast path and always routes through `apply_linear`; `Linear.load_weights()` restricts `allow_partial_loading` to `UnquantizedLinearMethod`.|
|**fused_moe signature simplification and MoERunner cleanup** <br> `tensorrt_llm/_torch/custom_ops/torch_custom_ops.py`|Removes `use_dynamic_fc2_scale` parameter from `fused_moe` custom op, internal invocation, and `register_fake` signature; removes `MoERunner.clear_all_workspaces()` static method.|
